# What is AlloyDB AI Stay organized with collections Save and categorize content based on your preferences.

AlloyDB AI integrates generative AI into AlloyDB for PostgreSQL and AlloyDB Omni, offering AI-powered search with vector, hybrid search, and AI functions. It also provides natural language capabilities, conversational analytics, and inference features like forecasting and model endpoint management to build AI apps faster. Build enterprise-ready AI applications faster and with less complexity by bringing AI to your operational data.

[Learn more about AlloyDB AI](/alloydb/docs/ai)

![Vector search and AI functions thumbnail](/static/alloydb/images/ai-powered-search.png)

### [AI-powered search](/alloydb/docs/ai/vector-search-landing)

Perform AI-powered search in SQL, including high-performance vector search with fully compatible with PostgreSQL's `pgvector` extension, hybrid search combining keywords and vector similarity, and AlloyDB AI functions for embedding, ranking, and multimodal content generation.

![Natural Language in SQL Queries thumbnail](/static/alloydb/images/natural-language.png)

### [Natural language and agents](/alloydb/docs/ai/natural-language-landing)

Use everyday natural language prompts to generate executable SQL queries against your database schema. Empower analysts and developers to query data faster using AlloyDB AI natural language ([Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products#product-launch-stages)).

![Inference thumbnail](/static/alloydb/images/inference.png)

### [Inference](/alloydb/docs/ai/perform-time-series-forecasting)

Perform time-series forecasting, bring your own machine learning models (BYOML) to run within AlloyDB, and manage connections to external model endpoints for diverse inference needs, such as predictions, content generation, and summarization.

**Note:** The AI functions and AlloyDB AI natural language features are in [Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products#product-launch-stages). This experimental launch is a Pre-GA offering.
